record.question: In slow stretching and holding method:
options: The joint slowly stretch and allows the muscles to remain stretched for a long time and then is slowly brought back to the original position.
The joint concerned is stretch with a swing and can be done rhythmically with a count.
The joint is slowly stretched its maximum limit and is the held therefore about 4-8 seconds and slowly brought back to the original position.
